## What happened

Describe the problem and what you expected. Check [project status](https://github.com/christianfurr/Kokiri/blob/HEAD/STATUS.md) for known limits.

## Reproduce

List the steps. For gameplay, include the area, route and camera/movement sequence, and whether a repeat visit behaves differently.

## Build and Mac

- Source commit / app build:
- macOS version:
- Apple chip and RAM:
- Internal and output resolution:
- Frame lock / frame generation:
- Preparation mode / cache state, if known:

## Evidence

Include sanitized observations or an app screenshot if useful. Separate observed game frames from generated frames, and label older recordings by date/build.

Keep game files, firmware, keys, saves, extracted shaders, caches, generated apps and private logs out of public attachments. Remove personal paths from screenshots and error excerpts. See [contributing](https://github.com/christianfurr/Kokiri/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md).
